applicabilityBasis.summary: USDGO is publicly described as a U.S. dollar token issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with 1:1 redemption and reserve attestations.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. holds an OCC national trust bank charter (granted 2021) and is an uninsured national trust bank — not FDIC-insured and not an IDI subsidiary. Under the GENIUS Act, the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway covers uninsured national banks chartered by the OCC approved to issue payment stablecoins; this is the correct pathway for Anchorage. Anchorage has publicly announced intent to qualify as a PPSI and submitted comment letters to the OCC on the GENIUS Act NPRM, but no PPSI approval or formal application has been submitted — the approval framework is still in proposed-rules rulemaking as of 2026-06-18 (GENIUS Act effective Jan 18, 2027 or 120 days after final rules). No token-specific public OCC GENIUS approval found for USDGO.
